div.head: I Cn 16a
div.ab: And to Sancta Marian mæssan ælcere ⁊ to ælces apostoles mæssan fæstan, buton Philippi et Jacobi we ne beodað nan fæsten for ðan eastorlicon freolse, ⁊ ælce[s] Frígdæges fæston, buton hit freols sy.

And at all the festivals of St Mary and at the festival of every apostle a fast [shall be observed]—except at the festival of St Philip and St James when we do not enjoin a fast because of the Easter festival—and a fast [shall be observed] every Friday, unless it be a festival.

And to Sancta Marian mæssan ælcere ⁊ to ælces apostoles mæssan fæste man, butan to Philippi & Iacobi mæssan we ne beodað nan fæsten, for þam easterlican freolse, ⁊ ælces Frigedæges fæsten, butan hit freols sig.
